notes.zh: 修复手机 / PWA 在更窄屏幕（360/320）或系统显示缩放较大时，顶部栏（主题选择、社交图标）与导入照片后的工具栏（全选、全不选等）被顶出屏幕的问题：手机端隐藏顶部社交外链、收缩主题下拉与工具栏按钮，现在 320 宽也能一行完整显示；PWA 新增新版本自动刷新，旧缓存用户下次打开即自动更新到最新版（build 19）。
notes.en: Fixed the phone/PWA header (theme picker/social icons) and the import toolbar (Select all/None/etc.) being pushed off-screen on very narrow (360/320) displays or enlarged system text scaling: social links are hidden on phones and the theme picker/toolbar buttons are compacted so everything fits on one row even at 320px; the PWA now auto-reloads once when a new version activates, so cached users update automatically on next open (build 19).
